section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) of 322 female university students examining consideration of cosmetic surgery, body appreciation (BAS), media influence (SATAQ-3), and demographics including BMI. The abstract reports negative correlations between BAS and BMI and states that lower body appreciation and lower BMI (along with greater media influence) predicted consideration of cosmetic surgery; no numerical correlations, age means, BMI means, or country/sample collection method are provided.
section_summary.evidence_source: Summary based on the abstract: "In total, 322 female university students completed the Consider subscale... the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS)... Bivariate correlations showed ... negatively correlated with BAS scores, age, and body mass index (BMI). A multiple regression showed that the only significant predictors of consideration of cosmetic surgery were greater media influence, less body appreciation, and lower BMI."
